basis.provisional: The remaining interaction, frame, resource, and soak thresholds are explicit proposals for physical-device comparison; they must not be used to claim PASS until the release owner approves them.

budgets.rationale: Aligns first usable state with the documented dashboard-refresh p95 ceiling.
Keeps tray-first restart responsive without treating package registration as launch proof.

budgets.metric: tray/flyout open plus first input acknowledgement
budgets.rationale: A human-interaction responsiveness floor; report p50, p95, and worst sample.
Requires a 30 fps floor while reporting a separate 60 fps target; avoids silently treating a VM result as GPU certification.

budgets.metric: dropped or stalled frames during declared workload
budgets.rationale: A low visible-stall budget for tray/dashboard/search workflows; must be measured with ETW/WPR or an equivalent frame source.
A bounded desktop baseline for detecting runaway WebView2/Win2D or scan retention; report exact dataset and architecture.
Catches sustained retention while allowing normal cache warm-up.

budgets.metric: WER/Application Error/.NET Runtime/fatal WinUI events during 30-minute soak
budgets.rationale: A release safety floor; the signed lifecycle verifier already rejects fatal launch events.

idle and active CPU/private bytes/GPU/disk I/O
sleep/wake, Explorer restart, process restart, and 30-minute soak
